default.question: How do I register for a race?
default.answer: Click ‘Browse Races’ from the homepage, find your event, and click ‘Register Now’. You’ll need a free runner account. The process takes about 5 minutes.

default.question: What distances do you offer?
default.answer: Sprint Triathlons (swim 0.5 mi, bike 12.4 mi, run 3.1 mi), Aquathlons (swim + run), and running events including 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon distances.

default.question: What is included in my registration?
default.answer: All registrations include: finisher medal, swag bag, chip timing and results, post-race celebration, course support, and aid stations.

default.question: Can I transfer or get a refund?
default.answer: Transfer policies vary by event. Please contact us at least 14 days before race day. Refunds are generally not available but registration transfers may be possible.

default.question: Do I need previous race experience?
default.answer: Not at all! Mermaid Series events are beginner-friendly. Many participants complete their very first triathlon or running race with us.

default.question: When will I receive my bib number?
default.answer: Bib numbers are typically assigned 1–2 weeks before race day and will be visible in your runner dashboard and emailed to you.
